summary: Live trace stream produces duplicate session metrics when Live Trace toggle is enabled in Console
description: Issue summary: When a customer enables the 'Live Trace' toggle in Console (Tracing view) and starts a live session, the Console usage analytics shows duplicated session-start metrics (session_count and live_sessions). Impact: LexiconAI reports inflated usage numbers and unexpected cost projections for the dedicated pool. This appears to affect streaming traces only and does not always correlate with duplicate websocket connections in the app. Environment: Prod (us-east-1) on Dedicated cluster for LexiconAI. Observed behavior: Every time a trace event is emitted from the SDK during an active live session, Console increments session_count twice or more, creating bursts of duplicate sessions in the usage histogram. Expected behavior: Enabling Live Trace should increment a single session event per user session and update streaming metrics once per session initiation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer (LexiconAI) enables Live Trace from Console > Tracing > toggle 'Live Trace' ON. 2) Start a live tracing session from their application using SDK v1.8.3. 3) Emit 3-5 trace events over the websocket in the same session. 4) Watch Console > Usage analytics for the 'live_sessions' and 'session_count' rollups. 5) Observe increments happening more than once per session start (duplicates visible within the same minute).
logs:
Customer supplied logs show repeated 'session_started' events in the analytics ingestion stream (ingest-proxy logs) with identical client_request_id but different ingestion_sequence numbers. Sample lines: 
2026-03-10T14:12:03Z ingest-proxy.us-east-1 INFO session_started client_request_id=abcd-1234 seq=4521
2026-03-10T14:12:03Z ingest-proxy.us-east-1 INFO session_started client_request_id=abcd-1234 seq=4522
No duplicate websocket connections appear in front-end logs (socket id unchanged).
observed_impact: Inflated usage dashboard for customer, incorrect billing estimates, customer confusion and elevated support calls. No model inference errors reported; inference latency unaffected. Internal alert (INC-20260311-02) triggered for usage spike detection rule.
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: ingest-proxy retries are being treated as new session starts instead of idempotent replays.
- Checked SDK behavior: SDK v1.8.3 sends a client_request_id per session; LexiconAI confirmed same ID across repeated events.
- Correlation between duplicate session metrics and ingestion_sequence bumps in ingest-proxy.
- Ingest-proxy change #PR-9476 introduced a change to non-idempotent ack handling in Feb 2026; related PR referenced for review.
- Reproduced in internal staging when toggling Live Trace ON/OFF rapidly; race condition seen when consumer offset commit lag > 0.
- Tracing pipeline: websocket -> ingest-proxy -> kafka -> metrics-processor -> console-rollup. Suspect metrics-processor treats repeated events within a short window as separate session starts when Live Trace flag is active.
- Added temporary log-level debug on metrics-processor to capture event dedupe key generation (deployed to staging for test).

root_cause_hypothesis: Metrics-processor lacked a stable deduplication key when Live Trace flag was set, causing ingestion retry events with the same client_request_id but different ingestion_sequence to be counted as separate session starts. The recent ack handling change upstream surfaced the race condition under burst traces.
workaround: Disable Live Trace in Console for affected customer temporarily. This prevents ingestion path that triggers the duplicate-session code path. Alternatively, throttle client-side trace emission to avoid rapid retries until patch is live.
resolution_plan: 1) Merge dedupe-key fix into metrics-processor (PR#9845) to use (client_request_id + initial_event_timestamp) as the idempotency key. 2) Run canary in us-east-1 dedicated cluster for LexiconAI during low-traffic window. 3) If successful, roll out to all prod clusters with a staged 15-minute canary. 4) Backfill corrected rollups for the window 2026-03-10T14:00:00Z to 2026-03-10T15:00:00Z if necessary. 5) Communicate timeline and next steps to customer and billing for potential usage credits.
resolution: In progress - canary shows corrected counts in staging. Awaiting prod canary and backfill decision. Billing team looped for credits if backfill not feasible.
